claim.quote: we can conclude that at currently available statistical accuracy we observe the oscillations at the $2.9\sigma$ level

date.note: arXiv v1 date; published Phys. Rev. D 104, 032003 (2021).

key_value_text.quote: we can conclude that at currently available statistical accuracy we observe the oscillations at the $2.9\sigma$ level
key_value_text.value: Oscillations at the 2.9 sigma level: delta m^2_14 = (7.3 +- 1.17) eV^2, sin^2(2 theta_14) = 0.36 +- 0.12 (stat.)

name: Experiment Neutrino-4 search for sterile neutrino and results of measurements

significance.quote: Monte Carlo based statistical analysis gave estimation of confidence level at $2.7\sigma$.

summary.plain: With all data collected, Neutrino-4 still reports an oscillation pattern, now at about 2.9 standard deviations (2.7 in a Monte Carlo estimate), and says it will build an improved setup to check it with three times the accuracy.
summary.technical: All Neutrino-4 data 2016-2021: oscillations at the 2.9 sigma level with delta m^2_14 = (7.3 +- 1.17) eV^2 and sin^2(2 theta_14) = 0.36 +- 0.12 (stat); Monte Carlo estimate 2.7 sigma.

title: Experiment Neutrino-4 search for sterile neutrino and results of measurements
why_it_matters: The collaboration's final published statement of its claimed sterile-neutrino signal.
